rationale: S-0084-01 proposes a NaP-density knockout sweep on cells 767 / 637 / 762 (5 logarithmic steps per cell). This older 3-cell scope is largely superseded by S-0088-01-style binary NaP-knockout on the 4 cluster representatives from t0088 (cells 1604, 1634, 767, 1639), which is itself covered by t0090 Phase G's validation bundle. The continuous-density sweep aspect of S-0084-01 (5 steps per cell, vs S-0088-01's binary on/off) remains potentially valuable as a finer-resolution follow-up if t0090 Phase G binary knockouts indicate causal NaP-dominance. Reprioritising from high to medium; not rejecting because the density-resolution scope is not strictly covered.
